issues.issue: Persistent Work history prevented otherwise identical CargoPackets from merging.
issues.resolution: Remove the Packet flag, merge restriction, split propagation, save field and Work-cohort transport counters. Keep Admission and actual carrier transport diagnostics.
issues.save_compatibility: Write passenger_journey_routing v3, accept v4 and skip the retired named table field.
issues.evidence_limit: Existing real-map CPU, memory, Packet counts, Work and delivery observations describe the pre-fix design with altered merging. They are not measurements of the corrected implementation.

issues.issue: intent_wait_ge_4096 included Timed ServiceIntent whose planned_at was not initialized.
issues.resolution: Replace it with schedule_intent_age_ge_4096, restricted to estimated intents, and explicitly report Timed waiting age as unavailable.
